title: Book Three · Chapter 169: The Noodles at Four
story:
On the second Friday, Ronan receives another nine yuan at twelve.

His work envelope now holds forty-five. He puts the money away at home before he changes his shirt.

Anna comes at four. Mum is finishing a coat for a customer, and Ronan has offered to make an early supper.

“Cold noodles?” he asks Anna.

“I can cut the cucumber.”

They wash their hands. Ronan boils the noodles while Anna works at the clear end of the kitchen table.

Her cucumber pieces are thin and straight. His first few are rather thick.

Anna looks at the two piles.

“Two views of the same cucumber,” she says.

Ronan laughs and moves the thicker pieces aside. He cuts the next part more slowly.

“Better?”

“Easier to eat.”

Ronan leaves the next piece of cucumber beside Anna's board.

“You can do that part. I will watch the noodles.”

She moves his thick pieces into a little pile.

“Keep these too.”

“They are mine.”

“Then you have more to bite.”

He laughs and takes his bowl closer to the stove. Anna has room to finish her part without his hands reaching past her knife.

The noodles rise near the top of the water. Ronan looks at them, then back at the bowl waiting on the table.

“Does Mum want this sauce?”

“We can ask.”

Anna leaves the small dish beside the empty bowls. There is enough time for everyone to choose.

Ronan finds a place for Dad's later portion. He does not need to finish every job in the kitchen himself. Anna is making space for the cucumber, and he can give the pan his whole attention.

From the window, Mum says goodbye to her customer. Ronan moves the clean bowls clear of the doorway before she comes through.

He lifts a noodle from the pan and tries it. Then he takes the pan from the stove and finishes the noodles while Anna mixes the sauce.

Mum comes to the door after the customer leaves.

“It smells good.”

“The cucumber has no moving walls,” Ronan says.

She looks at Anna, who laughs and explains the old drawing joke.

They take three bowls to the table. Dad will eat when he comes home later. Ronan leaves his part ready in the kitchen.

Anna tastes the first bite, then reaches for the sauce again.

“A little more?” Ronan asks.

“For mine.”

He passes it. Mum tries her bowl and keeps it as it is.

For a while, they talk about food. Anna's mother makes a different sauce, and Mum asks what she puts in it.

Anna counts the things on her fingers. Ronan watches her hand, with one small cucumber mark near the nail.

After supper, Mum takes her book to the window. Anna helps Ronan carry the bowls back to the kitchen.

He washes. She dries one bowl and puts it on the shelf. Then she leans beside him while he finishes the last spoon.

“A good visit,” she says.

“No forms.”

“Only very large cucumber.”

Ronan smiles and dries his hands. She takes his arm, and they sit outside for a few minutes in the cooler air.

When Dad comes through the green door, he sees them together and asks about the smell from the kitchen.

Ronan stands to get his bowl. Anna stays beside Mum's open window and tells her the last part of the sauce recipe while Dad washes for his meal.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

cucumber＝黄瓜；sauce＝调味汁；thick＝厚的；recipe＝食谱、做法。

## 理解问题

1. 本章第二周九元到账后，Ronan工资信封余多少？晚饭有没有被写成新增收费工作？
2. Anna、Mum和Ronan对同一份调味汁有哪些不同选择？这次相处有哪些普通亲近？

## 读句子

**He cuts the next part more slowly.**

拆开看：He / cuts the next part / more slowly.

他／切下一段黄瓜／把动作放慢了一些。
